Name: Bentley Restaurant Photo Mode
Author: BentleyTheModder1
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Bentley Restaurant Photo Mode[/b][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]

Bentley Restaurant Photo Mode is a small, optional photography tool for [b]Bentley's Fast Food[/b]. It instantly stages [b]12 vanilla villagers[/b] inside Bentley's Restaurant so you can take a screenshot of the restaurant full of people. It's a separate mod, and Bentley's Fast Food never uses it on its own.

[line]

[size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Bentley's Fast Food if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it.[/*]
[*]Put the [b]BentleyRestaurantPhotoMode[/b] folder into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and load a save.[/*]
[*]In the SMAPI console, type [b]bentley_photo_start[/b] to stage the scene.[/*]
[*]Take your screenshot, then type [b]bentley_photo_stop[/b] to end photo mode.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Two console commands only: [b]bentley_photo_start[/b] and [b]bentley_photo_stop[/b].[/*]
[*]Instantly teleports 12 vanilla villagers into Bentley's Restaurant. Nobody walks there.[/*]
[*]Alex and Penny are seated. Penny is perched on the edge of a dining table, facing the camera.[/*]
[*]Sebastian and Abigail stay at the arcade machines.[/*]
[*]Sam, Haley, Emily, Leah, Elliott, Harvey, Shane and Maru stand around the room near the walls.[/*]
[*]Everyone is frozen in place, with no walking, schedules or wandering.[/*]
[*][b]bentley_photo_stop[/b] sends everyone back to where they were. Photo mode also cleans up on its own at the end of the day.[/*]
[*]Nothing is saved, and villager schedules are never changed.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.x[/*]
[*]Bentley's Fast Food (the original mod)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]

Shout out to me, myself, and I, and to all the people who use my mod. [i]Thank you for playing![/i]
